decision.summary: Within allowed context [580,660], a multi-axis transient begins ~615: E increases steadily, U drops sharply near 618, N dips shallowly. The E trend plateaus or slightly reverses after 622 but no definitive return to pre-event baseline is observed before index 660; U and N also lack clear recovery. Hence, the interval 615–622 is a candidate temporary offset with uncertain status due to incomplete return evidence.

intervals.observation: E rises steadily (~2 MAD) from index 615 to 622; U drops sharply near 618 (~3 MAD); N shows shallow dip peaking ~620. Return not observed within allowed context (ends at 660), and E shows only slight plateau/reversal after 622 without clear reversal to pre-event level.
